name: Birds Gather under the Spring Willow
material: hanging scroll, ink and color on silk
dimensions: Painting: 240 x 195.5 cm (94 1/2 x 76 15/16 in.); Overall with knobs: 280 x 204 cm (110 1/4 x 80 5/16 in.)
summary: This scroll depicts a spring scene with all kinds of birds, including one peacock with a hen among peonies.
